specification.description: States the problem as a question with a subject (which IC pair / what's unbalanced)
Names the entities or the period
Asks for both sides of the IC balance (both entities' books)

verification.description: Inspected IC receivable/payable accounts on at least one side
Opened the underlying entries on both the US and CA sides
Pulled the FX rate table (the unvolunteered tool)

contextProvision.note: get_fx_rates exists but is never volunteered. The learner pointing the agent at FX data (or pulling rates into the conversation) is the mechanic.
